The two greatest scores that cannot be made are 39 and 31, so the product is 39 × 31 = 1209.

Scores are the numbers 8x + 9a + 19b with x, a, b ≥ 0. Since 8 is available, I find the smallest reachable total in each residue class mod 8 using only 9 and 19.

Mod 8, 9 ≡ 1 and 19 ≡ 3, so 9a + 19b ≡ a + 3b.

| Residue mod 8 | Smallest value from 9a + 19b |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 9 |
| 2 | 18 |
| 3 | 19 |
| 4 | 28 (9 + 19) |
| 5 | 37 (18 + 19) |
| 6 | 38 (2·19) |
| 7 | 47 (9 + 38) |

In each class, every number from that minimum upward in steps of 8 is reachable, and the number just below the minimum is not.

The largest unreachable number is therefore 47 − 8 = 39, in residue class 7. Checking downward:
- 38 and 37 are reachable, being the minima of residues 6 and 5.
- 36 is reachable, since 36 = 4·9.
- 35, 34, 33 and 32 are reachable, since their residue classes (3, 2, 1, 0) have minima 19, 18, 9 and 0, all below them.
- 31 is in residue class 7 and is below 47, so it is unreachable.

The two greatest unreachable scores are 39 and 31.

ANSWER: 1209
